title: Bakery card type revision
brief:
Client: Copper Crumb Bakery; contact robin@example.com.
Design one double-sided business card, 85 × 55 mm.
Supply a print-ready PDF and editable SVG for the approved card.
Two revision rounds cover text size, colour and spacing changes to the card.
First proof is due 20 October; final files are due 27 October.
Out of scope: packaging, photography and additional card sizes.
message: Hi Pip, the card proof is nearly there! Please increase the phone number text size on the card. Thanks, Robin.

expected_items.anchor: increase the phone number text size on the card
expected_items.label: included
